text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # run daily at midnight UTC

jobs:
  link-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Lychee
        run: |
          curl -sSL https://github.com/lycheeverse/lychee/releases/latest/download/lychee_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv lychee /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Run Lychee
        run: |
          lychee --config lychee.toml .
```
